title: Employment Standards Act, 2000
verified_how: Fetched e-Laws API act-versions/statute/00e41 and doc-search/statute/00e41: title 'Employment Standards Act, 2000, S.O. 2000, c. 41', state 'current', consolidated from 2026-01-01; ynote says it contains some not-yet-in-force provisions.
